coverage.target: U3 only packages and validates delivery controls; it does not change the request-serving path or latency budget, owned by U1/U2.
Durable event and Outbox processing are implemented by U1/U2; U3 preserves the agreed service contract and topology.
The availability SLO is measured in staging for the running service; U3 defines delivery controls and cannot establish runtime availability.
Telemetry TTL and retention indexing/backfill are owned by U2; U3 preserves the deployed schema and infrastructure contract.
Runtime metrics, logs, dashboards, and alarms are owned by U2; U3 preserves their infrastructure and does not define service runtime telemetry.
